hindi: हे सब ओर से देने वाले, हमारे लिए सब ओर से वह ले आओ, जिसे हम तुम सबसे बलवान से माँगते हैं।
english: O giver from all sides, bring us from all sides that which we ask of you, the most mighty.
notes: śaviṣṭham is taken as accusative agreeing with tvā; a vocative śaviṣṭha followed by īmahe is also possible. The antecedent of the relative yam (the thing asked for) is not stated. The root of īmahe (√ī 'ask, implore') is the usual Vedic analysis.
lines_deva: विश्वतोदावन्विश्वतो न आ भर यं त्वा शविष्ठमीमहे
lines_iast: viśvatodāvanviśvato na ā bhara yaṃ tvā śaviṣṭhamīmahe

words.gram: 3 sg. pres. pass. √gṝ (or 1 sg. mid. 'I praise')

hindi: यह ब्रह्म-पुरोहित है, जो ऋतु के अनुकूल है; इन्द्र नाम से प्रसिद्ध उसकी स्तुति की जाती है।
english: This is the Brahman priest, who is seasonable; the renowned one, Indra by name, is praised.
notes: gṛṇe may also be read as 1 sg. 'I praise' (Indra by name, the renowned, I praise); the passive 'is praised' is used here. brahmā may mean the priest called Brahman or the sacred power; 'the Brahman' is kept as literal. ṛtviya = seasonable, regular, fit for the season/rite.
lines_deva: एष ब्रह्मा य ऋत्विय इन्द्रो नाम श्रुतो गृणे
lines_iast: eṣa brahmā ya ṛtviya indro nāma śruto gṛṇe

words.gram: pres. part. caus. √mah, m. nom. pl.

hindi: ब्रह्म-पुरोहितों ने मंत्र-गीतों से इन्द्र की महिमा बढ़ाते हुए उसे सर्प को मारने के लिए बढ़ाया।
english: The Brahman priests, glorifying Indra with chants, made him grow so as to slay the serpent.
notes: arka is taken as 'chant, hymn'; 'radiant' is also possible. hantavā is the Vedic infinitive of √han (hantavai).
lines_deva: ब्रह्माण इन्द्रं महयन्तो अर्कैरवर्धयन्नहये हन्तवा उ
lines_iast: brahmāṇa indraṃ mahayanto arkairavardhayannahaye hantavā u

words.gloss: unclear word (perhaps a people, the Anavas)

hindi: अनवों ने तुम्हारे घोड़े के लिए रथ गढ़ा; त्वष्टा ने तेजस्वी वज्र गढ़ा, हे बहुत पुकारे गए।
english: The Anavas fashioned a chariot for your horse; Tvaṣṭṛ fashioned the bright thunderbolt, O much-invoked one.
notes: The first word anavaste is unclear: anavaḥ te (perhaps the people called Anavas, or an adjective) is only a guess. takṣuḥ (plural) with the singular subject tvaṣṭā suggests the verb is shared across two clauses or the text is irregular. Sense of the whole verse is tentative; Indra is understood as addressee because of puruhūta.
lines_deva: अनवस्ते रथमश्वाय तक्षुस्त्वष्टा वज्रं पुरुहूत द्युमन्तम्
lines_iast: anavaste rathamaśvāya takṣustvaṣṭā vajraṃ puruhūta dyumantam

words.gram: 3 sg. inj. √spṛś (unaugmented thematic form; a subjunctive would be spṛśāt)

hindi: कल्याण, स्थान, दान; व्रतहीन व्यक्ति धन चाहने वाले की कामना को आगे नहीं बढ़ाता और धन को छूता भी नहीं।
english: Welfare, a place, bounty: the one without vow does not further the wish of the wealth-seeker, nor does he touch wealth.
notes: Sense is uncertain. The first na may be 'like' (as a wealth-seeker) rather than 'not'; the syntax of śaṃ padaṃ maghaṃ is unclear. magha~ has the candrabindu convention for anusvāra (maghaṃ).
lines_deva: शं पदं मघँ रयीषिणो न काममव्रतो हिनोति न स्पृशद्रयिम्
lines_iast: śaṃ padaṃ magha~ rayīṣiṇo na kāmamavrato hinoti na spṛśadrayim

hindi: सदा उज्ज्वल, सबका पोषण करने वाली गायें; सदा निर्दोष देवगण।
english: Ever the bright cows, nourishing all; ever the gods, faultless.
notes: No verbs; two nominal phrases. viśvadhāyasaḥ is taken as 'all-nourishing' (dhāyas 'nourishing, sustaining').
lines_deva: सदा गावः शुचयो विश्वधायसः सदा देवा अरेपसः
lines_iast: sadā gāvaḥ śucayo viśvadhāyasaḥ sadā devā arepasaḥ

hindi: इच्छा के साथ आओ, जब गायें अपने थनों के साथ मार्ग का अनुसरण करती हैं।
english: Come together with desire, when the cows follow the track with their udders.
notes: vanasā is taken as 'with desire'; saha 'together' (with vanasā). The addressee is not named. 'yadūdhabhiḥ' = yat ūdhabhiḥ.
lines_deva: आ याहि वनसा सह गावः सचन्त वर्त्तनिं यदूधभिः
lines_iast: ā yāhi vanasā saha gāvaḥ sacanta varttaniṃ yadūdhabhiḥ

hindi: मधुर पोषण के समीप निवास करते हुए हम पुष्ट हों; हे इन्द्र, तुम्हारा धन हम धारण करते हैं।
english: Dwelling near, in sweet nourishment, may we thrive; we hold wealth that is yours, O Indra.
notes: prakṣe is uncertain (loc. of prakṣ 'nourishment, food'). dhīmahe may also be 'we meditate on' (√dhī) or 'we place/secure'. ta is te before the vowel of indra (Sāmaveda sandhi); the exact sense of te is uncertain (gen. 'your' or dat. 'for you').
lines_deva: उप प्रक्षे मधुमति क्षियन्तः पुष्येम रयिं धीमहे त इन्द्र
lines_iast: upa prakṣe madhumati kṣiyantaḥ puṣyema rayiṃ dhīmahe ta indra

hindi: सुन्दर गान वाले मरुत् मंत्र-गीत गाते हैं; वह प्रसिद्ध युवा स्तुति करता है, वही इन्द्र है।
english: The Maruts of fine song sing the chant; the renowned youth chants forth—he is Indra.
notes: The construction of ā stobhati and the subject of stobhati are uncertain (ā may belong to the verb: 'chants forth', or be a separate chant syllable). svarkkā is taken as svarkāḥ with the visarga lost before ā.
lines_deva: अर्चन्त्यर्कं मरुतः स्वर्क्का आ स्तोभति श्रुतो युवा स इन्द्रः
lines_iast: arcantyarkaṃ marutaḥ svarkkā ā stobhati śruto yuvā sa indraḥ

words.gloss: for the best slayer of Vṛtra

hindi: वृत्र के सर्वश्रेष्ठ संहारक, प्रेरित मेधावी इन्द्र के लिए वह गीत गाओ, जिसे वह पसन्द करता है।
english: Sing forth for Indra, the best slayer of Vṛtra, the inspired one, the song which he enjoys.
notes: vaḥ is left untranslated (ethic dative 'for you'/'you'). jujoṣate is read as 3 sg. subjunctive 'he enjoys'.
lines_deva: प्र व इन्द्राय वृत्रहन्तमाय विप्राय गाथं गायत यं जुजोषते
lines_iast: pra va indrāya vṛtrahantamāya viprāya gāthaṃ gāyata yaṃ jujoṣate

hindi: हव्य ढोने वाला बुद्धिमान अग्नि जाना गया है, मानो उत्तम हर्षप्रद रथ वाला हो।
english: Agni, the wise bearer of oblations, has been perceived, like one with a joyous chariot.
notes: sumadrathaḥ is uncertain (su-mad-ratha 'with a joyous chariot'); na is taken as 'like' (not naḥ 'us'). The verse looks like a fragment. havyavāḍ = havyavāṭ.
lines_deva: अचेत्यग्निश्चिकितिर्हव्यवाड्न सुमद्रथः
lines_iast: acetyagniścikitirhavyavāḍna sumadrathaḥ

hindi: हे अग्नि, तुम हमारे सबसे निकट और रक्षक हो; कल्याणकारी बनो, आश्रय देने वाले बनो।
english: O Agni, you who are nearest to us and a protector: be kind, be a shelter.
notes: bhuvaḥ is an injunctive with imperative sense.
lines_deva: अग्ने त्वं नो अन्तम उत त्राता शिवो भुवो वरूथ्यः
lines_iast: agne tvaṃ no antama uta trātā śivo bhuvo varūthyaḥ

hindi: भग के समान अद्भुत अग्नि उदार जनों का रत्न प्रदान करता है।
english: Like Bhaga, the wondrous Agni bestows the treasure of the bountiful.
notes: mahonām is uncertain (gen. pl. 'of the bountiful/mighty'); 'treasure of the bountiful' vs 'treasure for the bountiful' not settled. Bhaga is read as a name; 'bestower, share' is also possible.
lines_deva: भगो न चित्रो अग्निर्महोनां दधाति रत्नम्
lines_iast: bhago na citro agnirmahonāṃ dadhāti ratnam

words.gram: m. nom. sg. or 2 sg. impv. (uncertain)

hindi: सबका; आगे; स्तोभ; आगे, या; होते हुए; यदि; या यहाँ; अभी।
english: Of all; forth; stobha; in front, or; being; if; or here; now.
notes: The sense of this unit is not recoverable; it looks like a fragment or damaged text (stobha is a chant-syllable word and may be a stobha rather than a verb). Translation is a literal string of the words, not a sentence. veha = vā iha.
lines_deva: विश्वस्य प्र स्तोभ पुरो वा सन्यदि वेह नूनम्
lines_iast: viśvasya pra stobha puro vā sanyadi veha nūnam

hindi: उषा अपनी बहन के अन्धकार को हटा देती है; उत्तम जन्म वाली वह मार्ग को घुमाती है।
english: Dawn drives away the darkness of her sister; by her noble birth she rolls on the course.
notes: apa ... saṃ ... vartayati is a verbal compound split by other words (apa-saṃ-√vṛt). The sister is Night (not stated in the line). varttani~ uses the candrabindu convention for anusvāra.
lines_deva: उषा अप स्वसुष्टमः सं वर्त्तयति वर्त्तनिँ सुजातता
lines_iast: uṣā apa svasuṣṭamaḥ saṃ varttayati varttani~ sujātatā

hindi: हम अब इन लोकों को सुखपूर्वक सिद्ध करें, और इन्द्र तथा सब देवगण।
english: May we now happily secure these worlds; and Indra and all the gods.
notes: sīṣadhema is taken as a desiderative optative of √sādh 'accomplish, secure'. The final nominatives (Indra and all the gods) are left open: they may be subject (with us) of the wish.
lines_deva: इमा नु कं भुवना सीषधेमेन्द्रश्च विश्वे च देवाः
lines_iast: imā nu kaṃ bhuvanā sīṣadhemendraśca viśve ca devāḥ

hindi: जैसे धाराएँ मार्गों पर बह निकलती हैं, वैसे हे इन्द्र, तुमसे दान चारों ओर जाएँ।
english: As streams go along paths, so may gifts spread out from you, O Indra.
notes: vi belongs to yantu (vi-√i 'spread out'). pathaḥ is taken as accusative plural 'along paths'; srutayaḥ 'streams, courses'.
lines_deva: वि स्रुतयो यथा पथ इन्द्र त्वद्यन्तु रातयः
lines_iast: vi srutayo yathā patha indra tvadyantu rātayaḥ

hindi: इससे हम देवों द्वारा स्थापित वाज प्राप्त करें; हम उत्तम वीरों से युक्त होकर सौ वर्ष हर्षित रहें।
english: By this, may we win the prize set by the gods; may we rejoice for a hundred winters, with good heroes.
notes: ayā is read as feminine instrumental 'by this' (noun, e.g. the hymn, not stated). devahita~ uses the candrabindu convention for anusvāra. suvīrāḥ = with good sons/heroes.
lines_deva: अया वाजं देवहितँ सनेम मदेम शतहिमाः सुवीराः
lines_iast: ayā vājaṃ devahita~ sanema madema śatahimāḥ suvīrāḥ

hindi: मित्र और वरुण बल से इडाओं को बढ़ाते हैं; हे इन्द्र, हमारे लिए प्रचुर पोषण बनाओ।
english: Mitra and Varuṇa make the iḍās swell with vigour; make abundant refreshment for us, O Indra.
notes: Unclear whether pinvata is 3 pl. (subject Mitra and Varuṇa) or 2 pl. imperative; iḍāḥ is read as 'refreshments' (iḍā) though it may be the goddess Iḍā. Medium-low certainty.
lines_deva: ऊर्जा मित्रो वरुणः पिन्वतेडाः पीवरीमिषं कृणुही न इन्द्र
lines_iast: ūrjā mitro varuṇaḥ pinvateḍāḥ pīvarīmiṣaṃ kṛṇuhī na indra

hindi: इन्द्र सबका शासन करता है।
english: Indra rules over all.
lines_deva: इन्द्रो विश्वस्य राजति
lines_iast: indro viśvasya rājati

words.gloss: in the Trikadrukas (a ritual name, three vessels/rites)

hindi: त्रिकद्रुकों में महान् और अत्यन्त बलवान् ने तृप्त होकर, विष्णु के साथ निचोड़े गए जौ-मिले सोम को इच्छानुसार पिया। वह महान् कर्म करने के लिए उल्लसित हुआ, उस महान् और विशाल को; वह देव, सत्य बूँद, उस देव, सत्य इन्द्र का साथ दे।
english: In the Trikadrukas the mighty, very strong one, delighting, drank at his pleasure the barley-mixed Soma pressed along with Viṣṇu. He rejoiced to do the great deed, the great and wide one; may the god, the true drop, follow him, the god, the true Indra.
notes: Trikadrukas is a ritual name (three vessels or rites) kept untranslated. viṣṇunā sutam may be 'pressed by Viṣṇu' or 'pressed together with Viṣṇu'. īm and mahām urum are taken as 'him' and his epithets (uncertain); saścat taken as a 3 sg. aorist subjunctive wish. The candrabindu (~) in mahāmuru~, saina~, deva~ marks anusvāra/final m.
lines_deva: त्रिकद्रुकेषु महिषो यवाशिरं तुविशुष्मस्तृम्पत्सोममपिबद्विष्णुना सुतं यथावशम्
स ईं ममाद महि कर्म कर्त्तवे महामुरुँ सैनँ सश्चद्देवो देवँ सत्य इन्दुः सत्यमिन्द्रम्
lines_iast: trikadrukeṣu mahiṣo yavāśiraṃ tuviśuṣmastṛmpatsomamapibadviṣṇunā sutaṃ yathāvaśam
sa īṃ mamāda mahi karma karttave mahāmuru~ saina~ saścaddevo deva~ satya induḥ satyamindram

words.gloss: in the abode, in the day (uncertain)
of the cow, of the ray

hindi: यह सहस्र, कवियों की दृष्टि, मति, ज्योति और आधार है; उस लाल रंग वाले ने मिली हुई, निर्दोष, एकमन उषाओं को गति दी; स्फूर्तिमान् लोग गौ के ज्ञान से निवास में।
english: This one, a thousand [unclear], the sight of the seers, the thought, the light and the support; the ruddy one set in motion the joined, faultless, like-minded dawns, in the abode; the spirited ones, by the knowledge of the cow.
notes: Heavily uncertain. sahasramānavo cannot be resolved (sahasram ānavaḥ vs sahasra-mānavaḥ); vidharma is taken as vi-dharma 'support'; the clause with svasare ... citā goḥ is not resolved ('cow' may be 'ray'); the translation is a literal string of the words, not a firm sentence. aya~ = ayaṃ with candrabindu for anusvāra.
lines_deva: अयँ सहस्रमानवो दृशः कवीनां मतिर्ज्योतिर्विधर्म
ब्रध्नः समीचीरुषसः समैरयदरेपसः सोचेतसः स्वसरे मन्युमन्तश्चिता गोः
lines_iast: aya~ sahasramānavo dṛśaḥ kavīnāṃ matirjyotirvidharma
bradhnaḥ samīcīruṣasaḥ samairayadarepasaḥ socetasaḥ svasare manyumantaścitā goḥ

words.gloss: for the winning of the prize
for the winning of the prize

hindi: हे इन्द्र, दूर से हमारे पास आओ; यह मनुष्य यज्ञों की ओर, यज्ञों के समान, सज्जनों का स्वामी, धनुर्धर; राजा के समान सज्जनों का स्वामी। हम हविवाले निचोड़े जाने के अवसरों पर तुम्हें बुलाते हैं, जैसे पुत्र पिता को, वाज की प्राप्ति के लिए, सबसे उदार को, वाज की प्राप्ति के लिए।
english: Come, Indra, near to us from afar; this man toward, like rites, the lord of the good, the archer, like a king, the lord of the good. With offerings we call you here at the pressings, as sons call a father, for the winning of the prize—you, the most bountiful, for the winning of the prize.
notes: nāyamacchā is unclear: nā ayam acchā ('this man toward') is a guess (alternatively na ayam). astā 'archer' (or 'home') is uncertain, and the first half-verse syntax is tentative. putrāso na pitaraṃ: 'as sons (call) a father'. ma~hiṣṭhaṃ has the candrabindu convention for anusvāra.
lines_deva: एन्द्र याह्युप नः परावतो नायमच्छा विदथानीव सत्पतिरस्ता राजेव सत्पतिः
हवामहे त्वा प्रयस्वन्तः सुतेष्वा पुत्रासो न पितरं वाजसातये मँहिष्ठं वाजसातये
lines_iast: endra yāhyupa naḥ parāvato nāyamacchā vidathānīva satpatirastā rājeva satpatiḥ
havāmahe tvā prayasvantaḥ suteṣvā putrāso na pitaraṃ vājasātaye ma~hiṣṭhaṃ vājasātaye

words.gram: pres. part. mid. √dhā, m. acc. sg.

words.gloss: unopposed, not to be turned back

hindi: उस इन्द्र को मैं पुकारता हूँ, उदार, उग्र को, जो यशों को पूर्णतः धारण करता है, जिसे कोई पीछे नहीं हटा सकता, जो प्रचुर है। सबसे उदार, स्तुतियों से पूजनीय वह इधर लौट आया है; वज्रधारी हमारे धन के लिए सब मार्ग सुगम करे।
english: Him, Indra, I call, the bountiful, the mighty, holding glories altogether, not to be turned back, abundant. The most bountiful, worthy of worship through songs, has turned hither; may the wielder of the thunderbolt make all paths good for our wealth.
notes: satrā dadhānam is taken as 'holding altogether' (alternatively 'bearing forces'); bhūriḥ is read as nom. sg. 'abundant', agreeing with Indra, though a neuter bhūri 'many' (with śravāṃsi) is possible. The candrabindu (~) in ugra~, apratiṣkuta~, śravā~si, ma~hiṣṭho marks anusvāra.
lines_deva: तमिन्द्रं जोहवीमि मघवानमुग्रँ सत्रा दधानमप्रतिष्कुतँ श्रवाँसि भूरिः
मँहिष्ठो गीर्भिरा च यज्ञियो ववर्त्त राये नो विश्वा सुपथा कृणोतु वज्री
lines_iast: tamindraṃ johavīmi maghavānamugra~ satrā dadhānamapratiṣkuta~ śravā~si bhūriḥ
ma~hiṣṭho gīrbhirā ca yajñiyo vavartta rāye no viśvā supathā kṛṇotu vajrī

words.gram: 3 sg. pf. mid. √dhā (or 1 sg.); written dadha before ā
1 pl. pres. mid. √vṛ; written vṛṇīmaha before the next word
pres. part. mid. √kṛ, m. nom. pl.

words.gloss: for the newer, for the fresh one

hindi: 'श्रौषट्' हो; मैं प्रार्थना से अग्नि को आगे स्थापित करता हूँ; अब हम उस दिव्य बल को चुनते हैं, इन्द्र और वायु को चुनते हैं। जब दीप्तिमान के लिए कार्य करते हुए, नाभि पर बाँधकर, नवीन के लिए; तब अब प्रार्थनाएँ देवों की ओर जाती हैं, मानो प्रार्थनाएँ।
english: Let it be "śrauṣaṭ". With prayer I set Agni in front; now we choose that divine strength, we choose Indra and Vāyu. When, doing for the shining one, having bound at the navel for the newer one—then now the prayers go toward the gods, like prayers.
notes: The first two lines are fairly clear; line 2 (yaddha ... navyase) is uncertain (nābhā, sandāya, navyase, and whether vivasvate is Vivasvat or 'the shining one'), and the na in the last line ('like prayers') is odd. The printed śrauṣṭ is the Sāmaveda spelling of the call śrauṣaṭ. dadha and vṛṇīmaha show e → a before a vowel (as in te → ta elsewhere in this chunk).
lines_deva: अस्तु श्रौष्ट्पुरो अग्निं धिया दध आ नु त्यच्छर्धो दिव्यं वृणीमह इन्द्रवायू वृणीमहे
यद्ध क्राणा विवस्वते नाभा सन्दाय नव्यसे
अध प्र नूनमुप यन्ति धीतयो देवाँअच्छा न धीतयः
lines_iast: astu śrauṣṭpuro agniṃ dhiyā dadha ā nu tyacchardho divyaṃ vṛṇīmaha indravāyū vṛṇīmahe
yaddha krāṇā vivasvate nābhā sandāya navyase
adha pra nūnamupa yanti dhītayo devā~acchā na dhītayaḥ

words.gloss: to the one accompanied by the Maruts
to the one with fair armlets (uncertain)
to the one of joyful desire (uncertain)
to the one whose ways are stormy

hindi: तुम्हारी स्तुतियाँ महान् विष्णु और मरुतों वाले के पास जाएँ; पर्वत से उत्पन्न, एवयामरुत्; तुम्हारी स्तुतियाँ सेना के पास, पूजनीय के पास, सुन्दर आभूषणों वाले के पास, बलवान् के पास, आनन्दमय अभिलाषा वाले के पास, काँपते-हिलते व्रत वाले के पास, शक्तिशाली के पास जाएँ।
english: Let your hymns go forth to the great Viṣṇu, to the one accompanied by the Maruts; the mountain-born ones, Evayāmarut; forth to the host, forth to the worthy of worship, to the one with fair armlets, to the strong, to the one of joyful desire, to the one whose ways are stormy, to the powerful.
notes: The identification of the epithets is uncertain: sukhādaye (khādi 'armlet, ring'), bhandadiṣṭaye, dhunivratāya. evayāmarut is taken as a name (the sage's name); girijāḥ with the subject matayaḥ. Viṣṇu and marutvat are kept as given; later identifications are not imported. The line-2 datives are taken with pra yantu understood. girijā evayāmarut: how the two nominatives relate is unclear; both are kept literal, with no "hymns of ...".
lines_deva: प्र वो महे मतयो यन्तु विष्णवे मरुत्वते गिरिजा एवयामरुत्
प्र शर्धाय प्र यज्यवे सुखादये तवसे भन्ददिष्टये धुनिव्रताय शवसे
lines_iast: pra vo mahe matayo yantu viṣṇave marutvate girijā evayāmarut
pra śardhāya pra yajyave sukhādaye tavase bhandadiṣṭaye dhunivratāya śavase

words.gloss: of the back, of the top

words.gram: pres. part. mid. √pū, m. nom. sg.

hindi: इस भूरी दीप्ति से शुद्ध होता हुआ वह अपने सहयोगियों के साथ सब शत्रुताओं को पार कर जाता है, जैसे सूर्य अपने सहयोगियों के साथ। पीठ की धारा चमकती है, शुद्ध होता हुआ, लाल और भूरा। जब तुम सब रूपों के चारों ओर गायकों के साथ जाते हो, सात मुखों वाले गायकों के साथ।
english: Being purified with this tawny lustre, he crosses all hostilities with his yoke-fellows, like the sun with yoke-fellows. The stream of the back shines; the purified one, ruddy and tawny. When you go around all forms with the singers, with the seven-mouthed singers.
notes: The subject (the purified juice) is not named; the person changes from 'he' to 'you' (pariyāsi). sayugvabhiḥ 'with yoke-fellows' is taken literally. pṛṣṭhasya 'of the back/top' is literal.
lines_deva: अया रुचा हरिण्या पुनानो विश्वा द्वेषाँसि तरति सयुग्वभिः सूरो न सयुग्वभिः
धारा पृष्ठस्य रोचते पुनानो अरुषो हरिः
विश्वा यद्रूपा परियास्यृक्वभिः सप्तास्येभिरृक्वभिः
lines_iast: ayā rucā hariṇyā punāno viśvā dveṣā~si tarati sayugvabhiḥ sūro na sayugvabhiḥ
dhārā pṛṣṭhasya rocate punāno aruṣo hariḥ
viśvā yadrūpā pariyāsyṛkvabhiḥ saptāsyebhirṛkvabhiḥ

hindi: उस देव सविता को, दोनों के, कवि-संकल्प वाले, सत्य प्रेरणा वाले, रत्न देने वाले को मैं स्तुति करता हूँ, और प्रिय स्तुति की ओर। जिसकी ऊँची दीप्ति और प्रभा प्रेरणा में चमकी; सुनहरे हाथों वाले सुसंकल्पी ने अपने रूप से सूर्य के प्रकाश को नापा।
english: I praise that god Savitṛ, of the two, of a seer's will, of true impulse, the treasure-bestower, and toward the dear hymn. Whose uplifted radiance and light shone in his impulse; the golden-handed one of good will measured out the light of heaven with his form.
notes: oṇyoḥ is uncertain ('of the two worlds' is a guess; no case or meaning is secure). The second abhi (ratnadhām abhi priyaṃ matim) is taken as 'toward ... (a dear hymn)', with the verb understood. kṛpā svaḥ: 'with form/grace' (kṛp) is not certain. The candrabindu (~) in deva~, satyasava~ marks anusvāra/final m.
lines_deva: अभि त्यं देवँ सवितारमोण्योः कविक्रतुमर्चामि सत्यसवँ रत्नधामभि प्रियं मतिम्
ऊर्ध्वा यस्यामतिर्भा अदिद्युतत्सवीमनि हिरण्यपाणिरमिमीत सुक्रतुः कृपा स्वः
lines_iast: abhi tyaṃ deva~ savitāramoṇyoḥ kavikratumarcāmi satyasava~ ratnadhāmabhi priyaṃ matim
ūrdhvā yasyāmatirbhā adidyutatsavīmani hiraṇyapāṇiramimīta sukratuḥ kṛpā svaḥ

hindi: मैं अग्नि को, होता को, उदार को, धन के पुत्र को, बल के पुत्र जातवेदा को, प्रेरित मेधावी की तरह जातवेदा को स्मरण करता हूँ। जो देव, उत्तम यज्ञकर्ता, ऊपर की ओर और देवों की ओर बढ़ते हुए रूप से; घी की ज्वाला के पीछे, उज्ज्वल ज्वाला वाले, डाले जा रहे घृत की।
english: I think of Agni, the Hotṛ, the bountiful, the son of wealth and of strength, Jātavedas, like an inspired one, Jātavedas; who, the god, a good sacrificer, with upward form directed to the gods— after the flame of the ghee, of the bright-flamed, of the butter being poured.
notes: The first sentence is clear. vasoḥ is a genitive 'of wealth' (a form vasum 'good' may be intended) and sūnum vasoḥ sahasaḥ is read as 'son of wealth, of strength'. The third line is not a complete sentence in the unit; it does not close the clause begun in line 2 (the verb is missing). kṛpā is taken as 'form, grace'. The candrabindu (~) in agni~, sūnu~ marks anusvāra.
lines_deva: अग्निँ होतारं मन्ये दास्वन्तं वसोः सूनुँ सहसो जातवेदसं विप्रं न जातवेदसम्
य ऊर्ध्वया स्वध्वरो देवो देवाच्या कृपा
घृतस्य विभ्राष्टिमनु शुक्रशोचिष आजुह्वानस्य सर्पिषः
lines_iast: agni~ hotāraṃ manye dāsvantaṃ vasoḥ sūnu~ sahaso jātavedasaṃ vipraṃ na jātavedasam
ya ūrdhvayā svadhvaro devo devācyā kṛpā
ghṛtasya vibhrāṣṭimanu śukraśociṣa ājuhvānasya sarpiṣaḥ

words.gram: n. nom. sg. / f. acc. pl.

hindi: हे नर्तक इन्द्र, तुम्हारा वह पुरुषोचित कर्म, पहला, प्राचीन, स्वर्ग में घोषणा योग्य, किया गया; तुमने, देव की शक्ति से, प्राण को छोड़ा और जलों को बहाया। तुमने बल से हर अदेव को पराजित किया; सौ शक्तियों वाले ने ऊर्जा पाई, उसने पोषण पाया।
english: That manly deed of yours, O dancer, Indra—the first, the ancient, to be proclaimed in heaven—was done; you who by the power of the god released life, letting the waters flow, you overcame every godless one with might; the hundred-powered one found vigour, found refreshment.

text_flags.why: possible: vidāt 'he found' + ūrjam; the printed -e- looks like a spelling or sandhi variant
possible: vidāt + iṣam, as in the previous token

notes: apaḥ in line 1 is taken as 'deed' (apas), not 'waters' (as in line 2); nṛto is taken as vocative of nṛtu 'dancer, active'. prāriṇā is read as pra-ariṇāḥ (2 sg.), uncertain. The vided- spellings in lines 3 look like vidāt 'he found' (3 sg. injunctive); the words are given in the corrected form and flagged as possible typos or Sāmaveda spelling. The person shifts from 'you' to 'Śatakratu' (third person) in the last clause. The candrabindu (~) in videdūrja~ marks anusvāra.
lines_deva: तव त्यन्नर्यं नृतोऽप इन्द्र प्रथमं पूर्व्यं दिवि प्रवाच्यं कृतम्
यो देवस्य शवसा प्रारिणा असु रिणन्नपः
भुवो विश्वमभ्यदेवमोजसा विदेदूर्जँ शतक्रतुर्विदेदिषम्
lines_iast: tava tyannaryaṃ nṛto'pa indra prathamaṃ pūrvyaṃ divi pravācyaṃ kṛtam
yo devasya śavasā prāriṇā asu riṇannapaḥ
bhuvo viśvamabhyadevamojasā videdūrja~ śatakraturvidediṣam

words.gloss: of the juice, of the plant

hindi: तुम्हारा, रस का जन्म ऊँचा है; स्वर्ग में विद्यमान, पृथ्वी पर स्थापित किया जाता है। उग्र शरण, महान् यश।
english: Your birth, of the juice, is high; existing in heaven, it is placed upon the earth. Fierce protection, great glory.
notes: sadbhūmyā is read as sat bhūmi ā; a reading ṣaṭ 'six' is possible. dade is uncertain (1 sg. 'I take' or passive 'is placed'). The last half-line is a list of accusatives with no verb. The candrabindu (~) in ugra~ marks anusvāra.
lines_deva: उच्चा ते जातमन्धसो दिवि सद्भूम्या ददे
उग्रँ शर्म महि श्रवः
lines_iast: uccā te jātamandhaso divi sadbhūmyā dade
ugra~ śarma mahi śravaḥ

hindi: हे सोम, सबसे मधुर और सबसे आनन्ददायक धारा से बहो; तुम इन्द्र के पीने के लिए निचोड़े गए हो।
english: Flow, O Soma, with the sweetest, most exhilarating stream; you are pressed for Indra to drink.
lines_deva: स्वादिष्ठया मदिष्ठया पवस्व सोम धारया
इन्द्राय पातवे सुतः
lines_iast: svādiṣṭhayā madiṣṭhayā pavasva soma dhārayā
indrāya pātave sutaḥ

words.gloss: for the one accompanied by the Maruts

words.gram: pres. part. mid. √dhā, m. nom. sg.

hindi: हे वृषा, धारा से बहो, और मरुतों वाले के लिए आनन्ददायक बनो; सबको बल से धारण करते हुए।
english: O bull, flow in a stream, and be exhilarating for the one accompanied by the Maruts, holding all things with might.
notes: The one accompanied by the Maruts (marutvat) is not named in the line. ca after marutvate links the two parts: 'flow ... and exhilarating for ...'.
lines_deva: वृषा पवस्व धारया मरुत्वते च मत्सरः
विश्वा दधान ओजसा
lines_iast: vṛṣā pavasva dhārayā marutvate ca matsaraḥ
viśvā dadhāna ojasā

hindi: तुम्हारा जो वरणीय मद है, उसी रस के साथ बहो, देवों को प्रसन्न करने वाले, बुरा चाहने वाले को मारने वाले।
english: With that choice exhilarating drink of yours, flow with the juice, you who favour the gods, slayer of the evil-wisher.
notes: devāvīḥ may also be 'protecting/delighting the gods'. aghaśa~sahā has the candrabindu convention for anusvāra (aghaśaṃsa-hā).
lines_deva: यस्ते मदो वरेण्यस्तेना पवस्वान्धसा
देवावीरघशँसहा
lines_iast: yaste mado vareṇyastenā pavasvāndhasā
devāvīraghaśa~sahā

words.gram: pres. part. intens. √krand, m. nom. sg.

hindi: तीन वाणियाँ उठती हैं; गौएँ, दुधारू गौएँ रँभाती हैं; पिंगल वर्ण वाला गरजता हुआ आता है।
english: Three voices rise; the cows, the milch cows, low; the tawny one comes roaring.
notes: hariḥ is kept literal ('tawny one'); the line does not name him.
lines_deva: तिस्रो वाच उदीरते गावो मिमन्ति धेनवः
हरिरेति कनिक्रदत्
lines_iast: tisro vāca udīrate gāvo mimanti dhenavaḥ
harireti kanikradat

words.gloss: for the one accompanied by the Maruts
of the chant, of the radiance

hindi: हे बूँद, मरुतों वाले इन्द्र के लिए बहो, सबसे मधुर; मंत्र-गीत के आसन में बैठने के लिए।
english: Flow, O drop, for Indra, the one accompanied by the Maruts, sweetest, to settle in the seat of the chant.
notes: indrāya is Indra; marutvate is 'the one accompanied by the Maruts' (the same figure is understood but not stated). arka may be 'chant' or 'radiance/sun'. āsadam is the Vedic infinitive 'to sit in'.
lines_deva: इन्द्रायेन्दो मरुत्वते पवस्व मधुमत्तमः
अर्कस्य योनिमासदम्
lines_iast: indrāyendo marutvate pavasva madhumattamaḥ
arkasya yonimāsadam

hindi: डंठल आनन्द के लिए जलों में निचोड़ा गया है, कुशल, पर्वत पर रहने वाला; बाज की तरह वह अपने आसन पर बैठा।
english: The shoot has been pressed for exhilaration, in the waters, vigorous, mountain-dwelling; like a falcon it has settled in its seat.
notes: aṃśu is the Soma shoot. 'in the waters' (apsu) is taken with the pressing. asāvya~śu: asāvi + aṃśuḥ, with the candrabindu convention for anusvāra.
lines_deva: असाव्यँशुर्मदायाप्सु दक्षो गिरिष्ठाः
श्येनो न योनिमासदत्
lines_iast: asāvya~śurmadāyāpsu dakṣo giriṣṭhāḥ
śyeno na yonimāsadat

hindi: हे पिंगल वर्ण वाले, बल सिद्ध करने वाले, देवों के पीने के लिए बहो; मरुतों के लिए, वायु के लिए तुम आनन्द-रस हो।
english: Flow, accomplisher of vigour, for the gods to drink, O tawny one; for the Maruts, for Vāyu, you are the exhilarating drink.
notes: dakṣasādhano is taken as nominative with visarga turned to o (vocative sense). madaḥ: the verb 'you are' is understood.
lines_deva: पवस्व दक्षसाधनो देवेभ्यः पीतये हरे
मरुद्भ्यो वायवे मदः
lines_iast: pavasva dakṣasādhano devebhyaḥ pītaye hare
marudbhyo vāyave madaḥ

hindi: गरजता हुआ, पर्वत पर रहने वाला सोम छन्नी में चारों ओर बह निकला; मदों में तुम सब कुछ देने वाले हो।
english: The resounding Soma, dwelling on the mountain, flowed around in the filter; in the exhilarations you are all-bestowing.
notes: sarvadhā asi: sarvadhāḥ 'all-bestowing' is taken as a noun; 'in every way' (sarvadhā adv.) is an alternative reading.
lines_deva: परि स्वानो गिरिष्ठाः पवित्रे सोमो अक्षरत्
मदेषु सर्वधा असि
lines_iast: pari svāno giriṣṭhāḥ pavitre somo akṣarat
madeṣu sarvadhā asi

hindi: कवि स्वर्ग की प्रिय वस्तुओं के चारों ओर, बल-अन्नों के चारों ओर, दो नप्तियों के बीच स्थित; कवि-संकल्प वाला ध्वनियों के साथ चलता है।
english: The seer goes around the dear things of heaven, around the vigours, placed between the two grand-daughters; the one of a seer's will goes with sounds.
notes: Low certainty. naptyoḥ (dual of naptī) and the double pari are unclear; 'between the two grand-daughters' is only a literal guess. vayāṃsi may be 'vigours' or 'birds/food'. The clause 'around ... around' with a single verb yāti is understood. vayā~si has the candrabindu convention for anusvāra.
lines_deva: परि प्रिया दिवः कविर्वयाँसि नप्त्योर्हितः
स्वानैर्याति कविक्रतुः
lines_iast: pari priyā divaḥ kavirvayā~si naptyorhitaḥ
svānairyāti kavikratuḥ

words.gram: m. acc. pl. (with naḥ); gen. sg. also possible

hindi: मद टपकाते सोम-रस आगे बढ़े हैं, हम उदार जनों के यश के लिए; निचोड़े गए, वे यज्ञ-सभा में आ गए हैं।
english: The Somas, dripping exhilaration, have gone forth for glory for us, the bountiful ones; pressed, they have come to the rite.
notes: maghonaḥ is ambiguous (gen. sg. 'of the patron', acc. pl. 'bountiful ones', or nom. pl.); 'us, the bountiful ones' (acc. pl., with naḥ) is used. Hindi 'मद' follows mada, 'exhilaration'.
lines_deva: प्र सोमासो मदच्युतः श्रवसे नो मघोनः
सुता विदथे अक्रमुः
lines_iast: pra somāso madacyutaḥ śravase no maghonaḥ
sutā vidathe akramuḥ

words.gram: 3 pl. pres. mid. √nī (written nayanta before ū)

hindi: बुद्धिमान् सोम-रस आगे बढ़ते हैं, लहरें जलों को ले चलती हैं, जैसे भैंसे वनों को।
english: The wise Somas go forth; the waves lead the waters on, like buffaloes the woods.
notes: The second half-verse's comparison is elliptic ('like buffaloes (go through) the woods'). The wise Somas and the waves are taken as separate subjects. nayanta is nayante with e → a before a vowel.
lines_deva: प्र सोमासो विपश्चितोऽपो नयन्त ऊर्मयः
वनानि महिषा इव
lines_iast: pra somāso vipaścito'po nayanta ūrmayaḥ
vanāni mahiṣā iva

hindi: हे बूँद, बहो; निचोड़े गए वृषा, हमें लोगों के बीच यशस्वी बनाओ और सब शत्रुताओं को दूर मार भगाओ।
english: Flow, O drop, pressed bull; make us glorious among the people and strike away all hostilities.
lines_deva: पवस्वेन्दो वृषा सुतः कृधी नो यशसो जने
विश्वा अप द्विषो जहि
lines_iast: pavasvendo vṛṣā sutaḥ kṛdhī no yaśaso jane
viśvā apa dviṣo jahi

hindi: तुम दीप्ति से वृषा हो; हम तुम्हें उज्ज्वल को पुकारते हैं, हे पवमान, सूर्य का प्रकाश देखने वाले को।
english: For you are the bull with radiance; we call you the bright one, O Pavamāna, who sees the light of heaven.
notes: svardṛśam may agree with tvā: 'who sees the light of heaven'.
lines_deva: वृषा ह्यसि भानुना द्युमन्तं त्वा हवामहे
पवमान स्वर्दृशम्
lines_iast: vṛṣā hyasi bhānunā dyumantaṃ tvā havāmahe
pavamāna svardṛśam

hindi: बूँद बही है, समझदार, प्रिय, कवियों की मति; रथी की तरह घोड़े को छोड़ता हुआ।
english: The drop has flowed clear, the perceiving, dear thought of the seers, sending forth the horse like a charioteer.
notes: paviṣṭa is the aorist middle of √pū ('has purified himself'). The charioteer simile is read with sṛjat 'sending forth'.
lines_deva: इन्दुः पविष्ट चेतनः प्रियः कवीनां मतिः
सृजदश्वँ रथीरिव
lines_iast: induḥ paviṣṭa cetanaḥ priyaḥ kavīnāṃ matiḥ
sṛjadaśva~ rathīriva

hindi: विजयी, उज्ज्वल, द्रुतगामी सोम-रस गौओं की चाह से, घोड़ों की चाह से और वीरों की चाह से छोड़े गए हैं।
english: The prize-winning Somas have been sent forth, seeking cows, seeking horses, bright, swift, seeking heroes.
notes: gavyā, aśvayā, vīrayā are Vedic adverbial forms ('desiring cows/horses/heroes').
lines_deva: असृक्षत प्र वाजिनो गव्या सोमासो अश्वया
शुक्रासो वीरयाशवः
lines_iast: asṛkṣata pra vājino gavyā somāso aśvayā
śukrāso vīrayāśavaḥ

words.gloss: closely attached to men, in life (uncertain)

hindi: हे देव, बहो; तुम्हारा मद इन्द्र के पास जाए; अपने आधार से वायु पर चढ़ो।
english: Flow, O god, [unclear]; let your exhilaration go to Indra; mount upon Vāyu by your support.
notes: āyuṣak is uncertain ('closely, for men's life'). dharmaṇā is read as 'by support/ordinance' (dharman). The roles of Indra and Vāyu are literal.
lines_deva: पवस्व देव आयुषगिन्द्रं गच्छतु ते मदः
वायुमा रोह धर्मणा
lines_iast: pavasva deva āyuṣagindraṃ gacchatu te madaḥ
vāyumā roha dharmaṇā

hindi: पवमान ने वैश्वानर की महान् ज्योति उत्पन्न की है, जैसे आकाश की अद्भुत गर्जना।
english: Pavamāna has generated the great light of Vaiśvānara, like the wondrous thunder of heaven.
notes: citram could instead agree with jyotiḥ ('wondrous great light').
lines_deva: पवमानो अजीजनद्दिवश्चित्रं न तन्यतुम्
ज्योतिर्वैश्वानरं बृहत्
lines_iast: pavamāno ajījanaddivaścitraṃ na tanyatum
jyotirvaiśvānaraṃ bṛhat

hindi: गरजती हुई बूँदें आनन्द के लिए, बलपूर्वक स्तुति के साथ, मधु की धारा में चारों ओर बहती हैं।
english: The resounding drops flow around, for exhilaration, mightily with song, in a stream of sweetness.
notes: barhaṇā is uncertain ('mightily', or an instrumental agreeing with girā).
lines_deva: परि स्वानास इन्दवो मदाय बर्हणा गिरा
मधो अर्षन्ति धारया
lines_iast: pari svānāsa indavo madāya barhaṇā girā
madho arṣanti dhārayā

hindi: कवि चारों ओर बह निकला है, नदी की लहर पर टिका हुआ, बहुत अभीष्ट गायक को धारण करता हुआ।
english: The seer has flowed forth around, resting on the wave of the river, bearing the much-desired singer.
notes: pari ... prāsiṣyadat is a verbal compound split by pari. kāru 'singer, poet'; puruspṛham may also qualify the object of bibhrat in another sense.
lines_deva: परि प्रासिष्यदत्कविः सिन्धोरूर्मावधि श्रितः
कारुं बिभ्रत्पुरुस्पृहम्
lines_iast: pari prāsiṣyadatkaviḥ sindhorūrmāvadhi śritaḥ
kāruṃ bibhratpuruspṛham
